summary: Onity Group Inc. through its subsidiary OMC amended agreements to sell reverse mortgage servicing rights on ~20,000 HECM loans with $5.1B UPB to Finance of America Reverse LLC. Proceeds are estimated at $105-115M cash before costs and warehouse repayments, yielding net proceeds of $70-80M. FAR will also acquire Onity's reverse pipeline and assume certain employees. OMC becomes subservicer for three years with auto-renewal. Transaction requires regulatory approval, expected to close Q3 2026. Watch for regulatory clearance and risk-arb spread on estimated net proceeds.
